doc.name: A — matcha catalogue, water reflection, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: ceremonial matcha tin and whisk
Category: matcha
Shot programme: water reflection
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You are the visual lead responsible for this matcha product library. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the tilted dynamic in a water reflection treatment.

SUBJECT. A ceremonial matcha tin and whisk. Treat the attached reference as the single source of truth for the product's geometry, proportion, colourway, finish and label typography. Do not redesign, restyle, re-letter or embellish it.

CAMERA. Camera rolled into a deliberate tilt with the product on a diagonal. Shoot on a probe macro lens at f/2.8, framing for leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with LED tube accents in two contrasting hues placed in depth. Stage the product on or against cast pigmented resin, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
